description: Extract the real text, or a markdown table, from inside bounding boxes on given pages. Built for the hybrid path where a vision model locates a region and the exact characters come from the document rather than from a transcription. Coordinates are PDF points with a top-left origin.

Mode.description: What to pull out of each box.

oneOf.description: The characters inside the box, as flat text.
A markdown table, when the items inside the box form one.

PageRegions.description: Boxes to read on one page.

boxes.description: Boxes as `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` in PDF points, origin at the top left.

request_schema.description: Where the PDF comes from. Exactly one of the two fields must be set.

bytes_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes, for a document with no path. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

mode.description: Flat text, or a markdown table.

path.description: Filesystem path to the PDF. Mutually exclusive with `bytes_base64`.

regions.description: One entry per page, each carrying the boxes to read on it.

request_schema.title: Request

PageResult.description: Results for one page, parallel to that page's requested boxes.

regions.description: One result per requested box, in the order they were given.

needs_ocr.description: `true` when the extraction is not trustworthy: an empty box, a font the parser cannot decode, or text that decodes to nonsense. In `table` mode it also means no table structure was found.

ocr_reason.description: Machine-readable reason, when the cause is known.

text.description: The text, or the markdown table in `table` mode.

coordinate_origin.description: Origin convention the requested boxes were read under, always `pdf-points, top-left`. Stated on every response because a caller that assumed the other convention gets text from the wrong end of the page with no error. Note `pdf::extract-items` reports bottom-left instead.

pages.description: One entry per requested page, in the order they were given.

regions_needing_ocr.description: Boxes whose result should not be trusted.

source.description: Source label: the file name, or `<inline>` for an in-memory document.
